sections.label: Designing with people
sections.title: Service & Product Design
sections.intro: I use research to understand human experiences, then transform those insights into clearer journeys, accessible interfaces, and resilient public systems.

projects.title: Oppia Foundation — Empowering Young Learners
projects.problem: How do primary school students explore interactive lessons when using a computer for the first time?
projects.contribution: I researched how children navigate topic dashboards and lesson paths on laptops. By observing their natural choices and points of hesitation, I redesigned navigation cues, simplified lesson filters, and localized learning content into Swahili so every child can learn with confidence.
projects.status: Field usability research completed · Swahili localization published

image.alt: Oppia Place Values topic page showing lessons, practice filters, and the Start action
image.caption: Oppia Place Values interface evaluated in field usability sessions.

projects.title: Kuria Girl Child Development Center
projects.problem: Creating an engaging digital home to share grassroots stories against FGM and mobilize support for girls' education.
projects.contribution: I partnered with the Kuria Girl Child Development Center to create a modern digital presence that tells their stories with dignity, rallies international partners, and powers grassroots STEM and digital literacy workshops for local girls.

image.alt: Kuria Girl Child Development Center web interface from Behance

projects.title: KenyaConnect — Digitizing Citizen Access
projects.problem: How can public services be redesigned so citizens don't get lost in bureaucracy?
projects.contribution: I mapped end-to-end citizen payment blueprints and worked closely with government agencies to simplify multi-step public workflows. Using telemetry logs to identify transaction drop-offs, we optimized the self-service flow to increase successful completions and reduce citizen frustration.

image.alt: KenyaConnect redesign case study interface from Behance

projects.title: Trends-Sphere Boost — Merchant Campaign Builder
projects.problem: Small business owners often abandon promotional advertising when faced with complicated configuration forms.
projects.contribution: I redesigned the multi-channel campaign creation flow into a guided 3-step setup with interactive budget sliders and live audience reach forecasts, making digital marketing accessible to everyday merchants.

image.alt: Trendsphere Boost mobile app interface from Behance

projects.title: Cold Data Technologies — Infrastructure Web Platform
projects.problem: Translating complex data infrastructure capabilities into clear, trustworthy value propositions for enterprise buyers.
projects.contribution: A high-performance brand identity and responsive web platform for a modern data infrastructure company. I designed the information architecture and visual system to translate complex telemetry and archival storage solutions into transparent, compelling value propositions for enterprise buyers.

image.alt: Cold Data Technologies website design from Behance

projects.title: MaziwaLink × PamojaGov — Dairy Cooperative Service
projects.problem: Rural dairy smallholders face manual intake errors, delayed payments, and disconnected veterinary support.
projects.contribution: I formulated an integrated service blueprint and low-bandwidth mobile interface connecting dairy collection centers directly to county cooperative accounts, enabling automated quality grading and instant mobile money disbursements.

image.alt: MaziwaLink mobile and web app interface from Behance

sections.label: Contributing in the open
sections.title: Open Source & Research
sections.intro: I contribute user research, code, documentation, and practical setup guides to global open-source communities.

projects.title: Wiki Education — Evidence Lab
projects.eyebrow: Open Source UX · React PR Merged
projects.problem: Verifying citations on Wikipedia can be intimidating for student editors.
projects.contribution: I designed Evidence Lab—a guided verification interface placing citation texts and assertions side by side for transparent evaluation. Alongside the UX, I contributed directly to the Wiki Education React codebase, fixing date boundary handling and component initialization in a pull request merged into master.
projects.status: Technical pull request merged into master · UX proposed

image.alt: Proposed Evidence Lab workspace with a source reader, evidence card, and reasoning area
image.caption: Evidence Lab · proposed verification workspace for Wiki Education.

projects.title: Fedora Multilingual OCR Evaluation
projects.problem: How accurately do modern open-source OCR engines transcribe low-resource language typography?
projects.contribution: I benchmarked Tesseract, EasyOCR, and RapidOCR on Swahili and French documents, documenting error distributions and layout retention challenges. Alongside the benchmarks, I authored developer documentation for the Fedora and RamaLama communities.

image.alt: Bar chart comparing word counts in Swahili and French OCR documents
image.caption: Document analysis comparing character counts across Swahili and French texts.

sections.label: Investigating with data
sections.title: Data Science & Analytics
sections.intro: I explore complex datasets, uncover patterns, and design intuitive dashboards and models that help teams make informed decisions.

projects.title: Financial Guardian AI — Unmasking Debt Webs
projects.problem: How can multi-lending borrower data uncover hidden debt webs and default risks?
projects.contribution: In fast-moving digital microfinance, borrowers often juggle multiple hidden loans across apps without visibility, leading to unseen debt spirals. I analyzed borrower transaction patterns and built exploratory visualizations that reveal overlapping debt networks, helping credit teams detect over-indebtedness early.

projects.title: Kenya Renewable Energy Demand Forecasting
projects.problem: What can historical electricity data tell us about Kenya's seasonal consumption trends?
projects.contribution: With Kenya drawing the vast majority of its electricity from geothermal, hydro, and wind, anticipating seasonal peaks is essential for grid resilience. I analyzed national generation datasets and developed SARIMAX time-series forecasting models to predict consumption trends and support cleaner energy distribution.

projects.title: FlightRisk — Aviation Accident Severity
projects.problem: How can historical accident logs frame correlations around operating conditions and accident severity?
projects.contribution: Examining decades of flight safety records to identify operating conditions most closely correlated with severe outcomes. I cleaned and synthesized dense incident logs into exploratory data visualisations, highlighting how aircraft category, engine configurations, and flight phases influence survivability.

projects.title: YEN Africa Commercial & Sales Analytics
projects.problem: Translating multi-channel operational and sales data into strategic growth insights.
projects.contribution: Translating operational telemetry into clear business strategy. I validate and reconcile multi-channel sales and customer datasets, design interactive executive dashboards, and uncover conversion patterns that help the leadership team make informed growth decisions.
